answer: Pay earnings on a long vesting schedule with clawback, not instantly. Rewards an identity earns unlock gradually across many epochs along a slow ridge, and any identity later proven fraudulent forfeits its entire unvested balance. A fake cannot cash out on a quick zephyr of activity and vanish; it must survive the full horizon exposed to detection. Honest agents glide through vesting like velvet, realizing value they keep; a farm carries independent clawback risk on every head, so each exposed fake drags its own unrealized stake toward zero when caught.
